plan.title: English Rising Auction with Ceiling Price

steps.note: Open the single-stage event creation screen specified by the case.
Enable ceiling-price support required by the case.
Enable eRFX project creation as required by the case.
Allow vendors to be added during event creation so publishing is available.
Configure the closest supported auction type to the requested price-based forward auction.
Apply the first available auction template; the catalog cannot select a specifically named forward/sell template without its exact name.
Add the requested product and quantity.
Set the requested delivery location for the first line item.
Commit the 30-minute schedule with the event starting now.
Invite three QA vendors corresponding to Vendors A, B, and C.
Confirm that publishing reached a real project page.
Confirm Vendor A's bid was accepted.
Submit Vendor B's higher bid at 105.
Confirm Vendor B's bid was accepted.
Assert that the buyer's Responses view shows both submitted vendor bids and two of three invited vendors participating.
